lines.say: Steal this one line. It stops ChatGPT giving away your homework answers.
Homework doubt at nine pm? Don't panic. Make AI your tuition sir.
lines.show: Homework doubt at 9 pm? Tuition sir mode.

lines.say: One: snap the question and drop it into Gemini or ChatGPT.
Two, my favourite: tell it to explain one step at a time. No final answer.
lines.show: Step 2: one step at a time.

lines.say: Three: ask it for three practice questions just like it.
Now it's your tuition sir. It stops and asks you, what comes next?
lines.show: It stops at: what comes next?

lines.say: Here's the catch: AI can get maths wrong. So check the book's answers.
lines.show: The catch: check the book or teacher.

lines.say: Send this to the parent in your society group who's doing Class six maths every night.
lines.show: Send this to the Class 6 parent.

lines.say: Comment STUDY and I'll send you the free tool.
lines.show: Comment STUDY for the free tool.
